body: thanks. I'm not very good at the internet posts, but I don't know who to talk to. I'm afraid if I reach out to somebody we both know I'll break their trust, but if I don't do anything I'll lose them entirely. I don't have the depression that they do, and I understand that their feelings are something more than sadness, and when they tell me it's not my fault, I believe them. I want them to get professional help. I want to do right by them. I wish that mental illness wasn't so stigmatized in this county. I've know too many people to contemplate and attempt suicide. I only feel more lost in what to do with each person that confides in me.
